description: Probe catalog for China Unicom Cloud Drive. These items define what should be captured or verified so future automation can discover a usable session and stable request paths without changing provider code.

probe_items.goal: Capture a reusable logged-in pan.wo.cn session and runtime context.
notes: Implemented today by browser flow unicom_capture_current_session.

probe_items.goal: Verify QueryAllFiles on personal root and recover the working spaceType/root directory contract.
notes: Current stable operation is POST /wohome/dispatcher with QueryAllFiles on parentDirectoryId=0.

probe_items.goal: Verify AppQueryUser and extract available/used capacity plus user identifiers.
Verify QueryFamilyGroups and discover a reusable familyId.
notes: Current health path already auto-discovers familyId when possible.

probe_items.goal: Verify a file can be resolved to a real download URL and fetched.
notes: Current provider tries GetDownloadUrl, then V2/V3 fallbacks.

probe_items.goal: Record the stable CreateDirectory dispatcher operation and its static request defaults.
notes: Current static default is isCouldRepeat=1; dynamic fields are spaceType, parentDirectoryId, and directoryName.

probe_items.goal: Record the stable DeleteFile dispatcher operation and its static request defaults.
notes: Current static defaults are vipLevel=0, dirList=[], fileList=[].

probe_items.goal: Prepare the page uploader so runtime batch_no, directory_id, and personal_space_type can be captured.
notes: Implemented today by browser flow unicom_prepare_personal_root_upload.

probe_items.goal: Verify upload2C end-to-end and capture the uploader response contract.
notes: Current upload still depends on browser state and remains on the CDP/browser path.
